kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتفاقم (form VI)
# نَتَفَاقَمُ (natafāqamu) /na.ta.faː.qa.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَفَاقَمَ (tafāqama)
# نَتَفَاقَمَ (natafāqama) /na.ta.faː.qa.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَفَاقَمَ (tafāqama)
# نَتَفَاقَمْ (natafāqam) /na.ta.faː.qam/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَفَاقَمَ (tafāqama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
